package.description: 桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己干活，也能把专业的活派给编程助手。

en-US.description: A desktop AI companion that connects any model, does the work itself, and delegates specialist jobs to coding agents.
en-US.longDescription:
Nomi is an AI companion living on your desktop: bring any model, let it do the work, and let it hand specialist jobs to specialist AIs. Models, coding agents, MCP and local tools all connect in one place, coordinated by Nomi.
Connect a model once and every AI can use it: after adding a provider, Nomi itself plus Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok and dsh can use any of its models, or everything can switch to local models. The local gateway detects and translates between Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions and Gemini generateContent, so streaming, tool calls, reasoning, images and context compaction keep working.
Tasks can be limited to specific folders, coding assistants get a two-column workspace, and the desktop mascot shows speech and confirmation bubbles. The app runs on a Go core with the native WebView, installs per user without administrator rights, and needs the Edge WebView2 runtime, which is usually preinstalled on Windows 10 and 11.

zh-CN.description: 桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己干活，也能把专业的活派给编程助手。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Nomi 是住在你桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己动手干活，也会把专业的活派给专业的 AI。模型、编程助手、MCP 与本地工具都接到一处，由 Nomi 统一调度。
模型只接一次就能给所有 AI 使用：添加一次供应商，Nomi 自己和 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok、dsh 都能用它的任意模型，也可以全部换成本地模型。本机网关自动识别并互转 Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Responses、OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Gemini generateContent，流式、工具调用、推理、图片和上下文压缩都照常工作。
任务可以限定能访问的文件夹，编程助手有独立的两栏工作区，桌面角色会显示台词与确认气泡。应用为 Go 内核加原生 WebView，单个安装包约 39 MB，按当前用户安装，不需要管理员权限。
zh-CN.name: Nomi
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Nomi· 诺米 2.3.13
需要你做决定时，输入栏上方会出现问题卡；每个模型也可以选思考深度。
- Nomi、Claude Code、Codex 和 ACP 的提问都在这张卡上回答：字母选项，可以自己写、多选或跳过。停止、紧急停止、关掉会话或超时会结束这一问。命令和文件的允许 / 拒绝仍走原来的卡片。Codex 退回 exec 时问不了。
- 每个模型的思考深度合在模型选择里，只有会思考的模型才显示；默认是该模型自己的第二档，按这个模型能接受的参数发送。
- 上下文按每个模型的标准窗口压缩，默认 256K。已有分档（如 Claude 200K、GPT 272K）不变。认不出的模型也按 256K，不再按 128K。设置里还可以给所有模型设硬上限。
- 上游返回的模型名和请求的不一样时，回合底部会把两个都写出来。
- 编程助手检测不再卡在「检测中」：本地探测一结束就先显示已安装或未安装，最新版本在后台刷新（#350）。
细节
- 对话标题在消息发出后提前生成；侧栏和预览会显示运行状态。切换会话后立即贴到底部，不播放滚动动画。
- Diff 草稿保存前会校验版本，避免覆盖外部修改；保存失败草稿还在，保存期间继续改也不会丢。首次新建任务时如果已经离开任务页，过期的窗口不会再弹出来。
- 开发启动用独立的数据和端口，可以和正式版同时开；正式版的数据目录和运行行为不变。
- Windows 上打开 Computer Use 设置不再不停弹出命令行窗口。在一个对话里点过「允许」后，付款、发送、删除、系统设置和按坐标点击也不再询问；密码管理器和银行类应用仍然拒绝。
- Windows 输入法组字时，输入框里的字不会被抹掉，候选框跟在光标旁边；「添加文件夹」菜单也能完整留在屏幕上。
- 委派没指定模型时沿用你预选的官方模型；计划批准后的执行会继续被跟踪。工具输出里提到拒绝码时，不再误判为你拒绝并停掉自动续跑。
English
When a decision is needed, a question card appears above the composer; you can also choose a thinking depth for each model.
- Nomi, Claude Code, Codex and ACP questions are answered on this card: lettered options, free text, multi-select or skip. Stop, emergency stop, closing the session, or a timeout ends the question. Command and file allow / deny stay on the existing card. Codex's exec fallback cannot ask.
- Thinking depth lives in the model chip and only appears for models that can think. The default is the second tier in that model's own list, sent in the parameter shape it accepts.
- Context is compacted at each model's standard window, defaulting to 256K. Existing tiers (such as Claude 200K and GPT 272K) are unchanged. Unrecognized models also use 256K, no longer 128K. Settings can still set a hard cap for all models.
- When an upstream provider returns a different model name than the one requested, the turn footer shows both.
- Coding-assistant detection no longer stays on "Checking…": local install state is shown as soon as the probe finishes, and latest versions refresh in the background (#350).
Details
- Conversation titles are generated as soon as you send, and the sidebar and preview show running state. Switching sessions jumps to the bottom with no scroll animation.
- Diff draft saves check the revision first so they do not overwrite outside changes. A failed save keeps the draft, and edits made while saving are kept. A stale "New task" window no longer appears if you have already left the tasks page.
- Development builds use their own data directory and port, so they can run alongside the release app. The release app's data and behavior are unchanged.
- Opening Computer Use settings on Windows no longer pops command consoles repeatedly. After you Allow in a conversation, payments, sending, deleting, System Settings changes and coordinate clicks also run without asking again; password managers and banking apps are still refused.
- On Windows, IME composition in the composer is no longer erased, and the candidate window stays by the caret. The "Add folder" menu stays on screen.
- Delegations that do not name a model inherit the official model you already picked, and execution after a plan approval stays tracked. Mentioning a denial code in tool output is no longer treated as you refusing, so auto-continue does not stop.
